CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: mapeditor remove now automatically re-syncs the damage file's own rows to match a real object shift, instead of just warning about the desync -- closes the index-desync gap completely for everything the toolset can do (remove is the only operation that reindexes at all); verified live with distinct per-object damage markers correctly following their objects to the new indices (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
